opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000; travel grants up to £2,000-£2,500 per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects. Projects originating in the UK apply to the UK office; those originating in Japan to the Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK-Japan projects that deepen mutual understanding, encourage exchange of ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration between the two nations. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching and development, and academic research/visits/exchanges.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 per year; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Project must involve partners in both the UK and Japan. Preference to those new to UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants. Apply to the UK office regardless of where based.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or other costs including conference and publication costs.
